name: binhex-official-purgarr
description: Purgarr is a lightweight companion to your Arr stack designed to keep your torrent queue clean and ready for high quality downloads. Features Include: Cleans your torrent client of media imported by Sonarr and Radarr, Detects and removes stalled torrents, Adds stalled torrents to Sonarr's and Radarr's blocklist, Triggers a search to replace low quality torrents.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Specify the logging level for the application.

variables.name: PURGE_STALLED
variables.description: Specify whether to purge stalled torrents.

variables.name: PURGE_STALLED_INTERVAL
variables.description: Specify the interval for purging stalled torrents in seconds.

variables.name: BLOCK_STALLED_TORRENTS
variables.description: Specify whether to block stalled torrents.

variables.name: PURGE_IMPORTED
variables.description: Specify whether to purge imported torrents.

variables.name: PURGE_IMPORTED_INTERVAL
variables.description: Specify the interval for purging imported torrents in seconds.

variables.name: DELETE_FILES
variables.description: Specify whether to delete files after processing.

variables.name: RETRY_SEARCH
variables.description: Specify whether to retry search for stalled torrents.

variables.name: TORRENT_CLIENT
variables.description: Specify the torrent client to use.

variables.name: TORRENT_AGE
variables.description: Specify the age of torrents to consider for purging in minutes.

variables.name: QBIT_URL
variables.description: Specify the IP address or hostname to QBittorent webUI.

variables.name: QBIT_USER
variables.description: Specify the username for QBittorent webUI.

variables.name: QBIT_PASSWORD
variables.description: Specify the password for QBittorent webUI.

variables.name: QBIT_TOKEN_REFRESH_INTERVAL
variables.description: Specify the interval for refreshing the QBittorrent API token in seconds.

variables.name: SONARR_API_KEY
variables.description: Specify the API key for Sonarr.

variables.name: SONARR_LABELS
variables.description: Specify the labels to apply to Sonarr.

variables.name: SONARR_IMPORTED_LABEL
variables.description: Specify the label to apply to imported episodes in Sonarr.

variables.name: SONARR_URL
variables.description: Specify the URL for Sonarr.

variables.name: RADARR_API_KEY
variables.description: Specify the API key for Radarr.

variables.name: RADARR_LABELS
variables.description: Specify the labels to apply to Radarr.

variables.name: RADARR_URL
variables.description: Specify the URL for Radarr.

variables.name: RADARR_IMPORTED_LABEL
variables.description: Specify the labels to apply to Radarr.

author: binhex
